title: flow_event_instance_create input
description: Input for sending an event instance to an inbound channel of the event registry. Both an event definition reference and a channel definition reference are required — the engine rejects a body missing either.

eventDefinitionKey.title: Event definition key
eventDefinitionKey.description: Key of the event definition to send (latest deployed version is used).

eventDefinitionId.title: Event definition id
eventDefinitionId.description: Specific event definition id, taking precedence over the key.

channelDefinitionKey.title: Channel definition key
channelDefinitionKey.description: Key of the inbound channel definition that receives the event.

channelDefinitionId.title: Channel definition id
channelDefinitionId.description: Specific inbound channel definition id, taking precedence over the key.

tenantId.title: Tenant id
tenantId.description: Optional tenant the event definition and channel are resolved in.

eventPayload.title: Event payload
eventPayload.description: The event body as a JSON object, matching the event definition's payload contract. Must be an object — the engine rejects an array.

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector (full or partial UUID).
